 Cave Point E-Bike Rental

 ✅ Duration Options: 1, 2, or 3 hours
📍 Location: Jacksonport, WI
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Ages: All Ages
🛣️ Terrain: Backroads & Bike Trails
⚡ Speed: Up to 20 mph with pedal assist
💲 Pricing: 1 Hr – $30 | 2 Hr – $60 | 3 Hr – $90

Discover the natural beauty of Door County with an e-bike rental! Hop on one of our comfortable, eco-friendly e-bikes and cruise through scenic routes to Cave Point County Park and Whitefish Bay Dunes State Park. Whether you’re looking to enjoy the peaceful trails or take in the stunning views of Lake Michigan, our e-bikes make exploring these beautiful destinations effortless and fun.

 Door County Sauna Experience

 ✅ 2 hours · Relaxation & Wellness
🌿 Tranquil
🔥 Traditional Wood-Fired Sauna & Cold Plunge in the snow (winter) and Ice water (summer)
🌟 Guest Favorite for Rejuvenation
🌲 Surrounded by Scenic Forest & Lake Views

Up to 10 People

Step into a time-honored Finnish sauna beautifully built into an Airstream Sauna nestled in the heart of Door County’s wilderness. Enjoy the soothing heat of the wood-fired sauna followed by a refreshing cold plunge to invigorate your body and mind. This unique wellness experience combines relaxation, nature, and culture — perfect for anyone seeking calm, clarity, and connection in a serene setting.
